mainEntity.name: How much does an AI search content strategy for GEO cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an AI search content strategy for GEO varies significantly based on several factors, including the number of target locations, the scope of content required, the depth of AI analysis, and the duration of the engagement. Factors like competitive intensity in cities such as Dallas or Phoenix, the complexity of your industry, and whether the strategy includes ongoing content creation and optimization also influence pricing. A basic package might involve initial strategy development and keyword research, while comprehensive services could include continuous content production, technical SEO, and performance reporting. We recommend a consultation to provide a tailored quote based on your specific business needs and goals.
